author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
The @nationalportraitgallery had a solid plan to prepare an original pastel of George Washington from 1797 to go on display, when, in a pre-production meeting with Tested, Adam Savage asked a question that changed everything. Exhibition and matting specialist Eric Knutson explains. What do YOU think the writing on the back says?
